statement: The function returns a result r, and r viewed as a mathematical integer is the maximum of the set { cnt(s,c) - cnt(s,d) | 97 <= c <= 122, cnt(s,c) is odd, 97 <= d <= 122, cnt(s,d) > 0, cnt(s,d) is even }.
preconditions: Let cnt(s,x) be the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(s) and s[i] = x. Assume 3 <= len(s) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 97 <= s[i] <= 122; there exists a byte c with 97 <= c <= 122 and cnt(s,c) odd; and there exists a byte d with 97 <= d <= 122, cnt(s,d) > 0, and cnt(s,d) even.

statement: The function returns a result r, and there exist bytes c and d with 97 <= c <= 122 and 97 <= d <= 122 such that cnt(s,c) is odd, cnt(s,d) > 0 and cnt(s,d) is even, and r = cnt(s,c) - cnt(s,d).
preconditions: Let cnt(s,x) be the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(s) and s[i] = x. Assume 3 <= len(s) <= 100; all bytes of s are in 97..122; some letter has odd cnt; and some letter has positive even cnt.

statement: The function returns a result r, and for every byte c with 97 <= c <= 122 and cnt(s,c) odd, and for every byte d with 97 <= d <= 122, cnt(s,d) > 0, and cnt(s,d) even, we have cnt(s,c) - cnt(s,d) <= r.
preconditions: Let cnt(s,x) be the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(s) and s[i] = x. Assume 3 <= len(s) <= 100; all bytes of s are in 97..122; some letter has odd cnt; and some letter has positive even cnt.

statement: The function returns a result r, and r = O - E, where O = max { cnt(s,c) | 97 <= c <= 122 and cnt(s,c) is odd } and E = min { cnt(s,d) | 97 <= d <= 122, cnt(s,d) > 0, and cnt(s,d) is even }.
preconditions: Let cnt(s,x) be the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(s) and s[i] = x. Assume 3 <= len(s) <= 100; all bytes of s are in 97..122; some letter has odd cnt; and some letter has positive even cnt.

statement: For every such s, evaluation of max_difference(s) returns a result r; it does not fail, panic, go out of bounds, or overflow.
preconditions: Let cnt(s,x) be the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(s) and s[i] = x. Assume 3 <= len(s) <= 100; all bytes of s are in 97..122; some letter has odd cnt; and some letter has positive even cnt.

statement: The function returns a result r, and r is odd as a mathematical integer: there exists an integer k such that r = 2*k + 1.
preconditions: Let cnt(s,x) be the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(s) and s[i] = x. Assume 3 <= len(s) <= 100; all bytes of s are in 97..122; some letter has odd cnt; and some letter has positive even cnt.

statement: Whenever max_difference(s) returns r and max_difference(t) returns r_t, we have r_t = r.
preconditions: Let cnt(s,x) be the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(s) and s[i] = x. Assume s satisfies 3 <= len(s) <= 100; all bytes of s are in 97..122; some letter has odd cnt; and some letter has positive even cnt. Let t be any byte slice satisfying the same assumptions and satisfying cnt(t,c) = cnt(s,c) for every byte c with 97 <= c <= 122.

statement: The function returns a result r, and for every byte c with 97 <= c <= 122 and cnt(s,c) odd, and every byte d with 97 <= d <= 122, cnt(s,d) > 0, and cnt(s,d) even, if r = cnt(s,c) - cnt(s,d), then cnt(s,c) = O and cnt(s,d) = E.
preconditions: Let cnt(s,x) be the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(s) and s[i] = x. Assume 3 <= len(s) <= 100; all bytes of s are in 97..122; some letter has odd cnt; and some letter has positive even cnt. Define O = max { cnt(s,c) | 97 <= c <= 122 and cnt(s,c) is odd } and E = min { cnt(s,d) | 97 <= d <= 122, cnt(s,d) > 0, and cnt(s,d) is even }.
